items.title: TJX Companies Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: TJX Companies (NYSE:TJX) said third-quarter comparable sales rose 4% and adjusted earnings exceeded its expectations, as gains at HomeGoods and its international businesses helped offset a slower performance at its largest division, Marmaxx. The off-price retailer raised its full-year sales outlook

items.title: TJX Soars 11% on Above-Plan Q3 as CEO Expects Holiday “Sales Momentum to Accelerate”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTJX shares jumped 11% after its third-quarter comparable sales rose 4% and its earnings beat the company’s own plan. Marmaxx, its biggest unit, grew comparable sales 2%, and CEO Ernie Herrman expects further improvement there this holiday season.

items.title: Which retail stocks are best positioned ahead of earnings this week?
items.summary: Investing.com -- Six retailers still report this week, per the earnings calendar: Lowe’s (LOW), TJX (TJX) and Target (TGT) on Nov 18 pre-market, then Walmart (WMT) pre-market and PDD Holdings (PDD) on Nov 19. Ross Stores (ROST) reports after the close on Nov 19. Home Depot (HD) already reported this morning, so it is excluded. The calendar was filtered to high- and medium-importance names, so smaller retailers may be missing.
